ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity black pixels to 30% high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions are localized as large contiguous patches on the lower-left margin and lower-central keel region, while low-intensity black pigmentation dominates the upper lobes and central surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute, deep U-shaped depression with an estimated angle of 20-30 degrees relative to the lobe centerlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge featuring a deep rectangular notch in the mid-right lobe and high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the remaining visible boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep with a strong upward convex curve on the far-left tip and a blunted, irregular convex sweep on the right lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of roughly 7-10 circular, high-contrast white ring-shaped pixel patterns on the upper-central black surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss/missing segment on the mid-trailing edge of the right lobe and dense calcified barnacle clusters on the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive ring-shaped pigmentation/scars on the right lobe and heavy parasitic colonization altering the perimeter pixel-contour of the fluke tips.
